'''Z23-Y75''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] who served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] as a [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]]. The [[Battle droid/Legends|droids]] had [[Color/Legends|light tan]] plating with brown markings. Like other B1-Series battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]], Z23-Y75<ref name="GB" /> had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]], stood at 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and wielded an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Clone Wars" /> The droid also had a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] equipped with an [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Z23-Y75 appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' as a unique unit that could be placed in player-made scenarios. The droid has an identical game model and profile image to other unique battle droid units in the game. When placed in a scenario, Z23-Y75's model uses different colors from its profile image, featuring the player's alignment color on its chest and [[Limb/Legends|legs]], and the tan color common to other B1-Series battle droids on its head and parts of its limbs. Z23-Y75's name can also be mentioned as a commander for the Trade Federation [[Wikipedia:Artificial intelligence in video games|AI]] in the standard game mode.<ref name="GB" />
